Historically, our cohorts were named for the year’s peak atmospheric carbon dioxide concentration (in parts per million [ppm]), based on the Keeling Curve. D3 Launches First Cohort of Innovative Carbon Dioxide Removal Startups Skip to content Our Portfolio For Entrepreneurs Eligibility & Selection How to Apply Programs & Opportunities Innovation Cohorts & Partnerships Industrial Innovation Cohorts Future Industries Partnership Impact Archive Clean Mobile Power Initiative Cohort First Gigaton Captured Cooling Innovations Passive Daytime Radiative Cooling Insights & Events About Us Our Team Careers Our Partners Corporates Investors Mentors D3 Launches First Cohort of Innovative Carbon Dioxide Removal Startups Third Derivative July 19, 2022 Third Derivative (D3) launches a cohort of five startups to accelerate the effectiveness of scaling solutions to remove CO 2 from the atmosphere. Oakland, CA – July 19, 2022 Global climate technology accelerator Third Derivative (D3) today launched a focused cohort of five promising startups working on durable carbon dioxide removal (CDR) solutions. CDR is the removal of carbon dioxide from the air or oceans, as opposed to capturing emissions directly from power plants or industrial sources, known as point-source carbon capture. “According to the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, in order to achieve climate targets, we not only need to drastically reduce emissions, but also remove up to 20 billion tons of CO 2 per year from the atmosphere,” said Brant Richards, Managing Director of D3.
